field.eval: [(4, ref('group_dev_release_ship'))] + [(4, ref('group_%s_%s' % (m, p))) for m in ('dev_release', 'dev_feature', 'dev_ticket', 'dev_sprint', 'dev_epic', 'dev_space') for p in ('create_only', 'edit_own', 'edit_team', 'edit_all', 'view_all', 'delete_own', 'delete_all')]
